UI_GRAPHICS_MODE_D_HFR:

UI_SHIP_TGA_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>reforged starship<>, commemorating a time when Travellers old and new joined together to voyage across the stars.

This unusual ship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes.

<STELLAR>Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or <STELLAR>Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (<IMG>QUICK_MENU<>).

PC_GRAPHICS_AA_D_V2:
Anti aliasing uses various techniques to smooth out jagged edges around objects (which appear as a result of square pixels forming non-rectangular shapes).

<STELLAR>FXAA<> - Very fast filtering, but can result in a slightly blurred image.

<STELLAR>TAA<> - Fast multi-frame sampling that is sharper than FXAA.

<STELLAR>FSR 2.0<> - AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 2 is a cutting edge open source temporal upscaling solution, providing high image quality and improved framerates.

<STELLAR>Intel XeSS<> - Intel Xe Super Sampling technology uses machine learning to deliver higher performance with exceptional image quality.

This setting only affects GPU performance.
PC_GRAPHICS_AA_DLSS_D_V2:
Anti aliasing uses various techniques to smooth out jagged edges around objects (which appear as a result of square pixels forming non-rectangular shapes).

<STELLAR>FXAA<> - Very fast filtering, but can result in a slightly blurred image.

<STELLAR>TAA<> - Fast multi-frame sampling that is sharper than FXAA.

<STELLAR>FSR 2.0<> - AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 2 is a cutting edge open source temporal upscaling solution, providing high image quality and improved framerates.

<STELLAR>DLSS<> - An NVIDIA RTX technology which uses a deep learning neural network to boost frame rates and generate beautiful, sharp images.

<STELLAR>DLAA<> - NVIDIA DLAA is an AI-based anti-aliasing mode for users who have spare GPU headroom and want higher levels of image quality.

<STELLAR>Intel XeSS<> - Intel Xe Super Sampling technology uses machine learning to deliver higher performance with exceptional image quality.

This setting only affects GPU performance.
PC_GRAPHICS_XESS2QUALITY_D:
Intel Xe Super Sampling (XeSS) technology uses machine learning to deliver higher performance with exceptional image quality.

<STELLAR>Native<> - Delivers high quality anti-aliasing and sharpening without any upscaling.

<STELLAR>UltraQuality+<> - Delivers the highest quality visual upscale (1.3x resolution scaling).

<STELLAR>Ultra Quality<> - Delivers ultra high quality visual upscale (1.3x resolution scaling).

<STELLAR>Quality<> - Delivers high quality visual upscale (1.5x resolution scaling).

<STELLAR>Balanced<> - Delivers optimal performance and image quality (1.7x resolution scaling).

<STELLAR>Performance<> - Improves overall gaming performance (2.0x resolution scaling).

<STELLAR>Ultra Performance<> - Offers the highest performance boost (3.0x resolution scaling). Recommended for 8K resolutions only.

Default value is: <CATALYST>%DEFAULTVALUE%<>

This setting only affects GPU performance.
PC_GRAPHICS_DLSSFRAMEGEN_D_V2:
Frame Generation boosts frame rates by using AI to render additional frames.

<STELLAR>Off<> - Turns DLSS Frame Generation off.

<STELLAR>2X<> - The total number of frames is doubled, with one rendered and one generated frame. Supported on a GeForce RTX 40 Series graphics card or higher.

<STELLAR>3X<> - The total number of frames is tripled, with one rendered and two generated frames. Supported on a GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics card.

<STELLAR>4X<> - The total number of frames is quadrupled, with one rendered and three generated frames. Supported on a GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics card.

Default value is: <CATALYST>%DEFAULTVALUE%<>
UI_OPTION_SUIT_VOICE_D:
Sets the vocal style for situations reported verbally by the <TECHNOLOGY>Exosuit Artificial Intelligence<> (such as when receiving Units).

<STELLAR>Feminine Suit Voice<> - The Exosuit speaks with a feminine voice. Available in all languages.

<STELLAR>Masculine Suit Voice<> - The Exosuit speaks with a masculine voice. Available in English only.

<STELLAR>Suit Voice Off<> - The Exosuit does not speak.

Default value is: <CATALYST>%DEFAULTVALUE%<>
UI_OPTION_PLAYER_VOICE_D:
Sets the vocal range for vocalisations (such as breathing and grunts) made by the player character.

<STELLAR>Player Voice A<> - The player character vocalises in a higher pitch.

<STELLAR>Player Voice B<> - The player character vocalises in a lower pitch.

<STELLAR>Player Voice C<> - The player character vocalises in more exotic, alien tones.

<STELLAR>Vocalisations Off<> - The player character does not vocalise.

Default value is: <CATALYST>%DEFAULTVALUE%<>

DNT_BUI_WFC_OWNED_SEC_LANG_03: thank you for your contribution to our settlement, prebuilt-entity. we all see your hard work.

DNT_BUI_WFC_OWNED_SEC_LANG_11: ah. you are our overseer. the disruptor. our friend. welcome.

DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_02: i think i know your name. you are the disruptor. welcome to our settlement.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_03: you can see me, prebuilt visitor? please do not cause trouble.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_04: this is an autophage settlement, prebuilt-entity. please visit with respect.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_05: why are you here, prebuilt-entity? what technology sees through my protection aura?
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_06: i know you. you are the disruptor! i would welcome your contribution to our settlement.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_07: we are a hidden society, prebuilt visitor. you must be very advanced to see us.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_08: we built this settlement from salvage and from pain. please do not damage it.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_09: we return to existence to build this settlement. you are welcome if your visit is peaceful.
DNT_BUI_WFC_SEC_LANG_10: this settlement is hidden to most. but i think you are different.

UI_GUIDE_BODY_BIGGS:
Corvettes are a completely bespoke class of starship - assembled piece by piece - with a traversable, furnished interior. These habitable ships are constructed in a similar fashion to planetary bases, and can be fitted out internally with living areas such as nutrition units and bunk beds.

Excavate Corvette <TECHNOLOGY>modules<> from <STELLAR>salvage containers<> found buried on some worlds. Scan planets with the starship scanner to detect buried <STELLAR>salvageable scrap<>. Modules determine the aesthetics of the ship, and many modules also enhance specific ship <TECHNOLOGY>stats<>, such as damage potential or shield strength.

Begin Corvette creation at a <TECHNOLOGY>Corvette Workshop<>, found aboard <VAL_ON>Space Stations<> by the large landing pads near the station entrance tunnel. A number of basic modules can also be <STELLAR>purchased<> from the Workshop.

Select <STELLAR>finalise<> to complete a Corvette design, or exit the Workshop to resume it later.

Once a Corvette's structure is finalised, you can add internal decorations by stepping inside the ship and accessing the <TECHNOLOGY>Build Menu<> with <IMG>BUILD_MENU<>. The structure of a finalised Corvette can be also <STELLAR>modified<> at the Corvette Workshop at any time.
UI_GUIDE_BODY_BIGGS_ALT:

Excavate Corvette <TECHNOLOGY>modules<> from <STELLAR>salvage containers<> found buried on some worlds. Scan planets with the starship scanner to detect buried <STELLAR>salvageable scrap<>. Modules determine the aesthetics of the ship, and many modules also enhance specific ship <TECHNOLOGY>stats<>, such as damage potential or shield strength.

Begin Corvette creation at a <TECHNOLOGY>Corvette Workshop<>, found aboard <VAL_ON>Space Stations<> by the large landing pads near the station entrance tunnel. A number of basic modules can also be <STELLAR>purchased<> from the Workshop.

Select <STELLAR>purchase<> to finalise a Corvette design, or <STELLAR>save<> it to continue later. The cost <IMG>UNITS<> of the final fabrication step will be determined by the size and complexity of the ship.

Once a Corvette's structure is finalised, you can add internal decorations by stepping inside the ship and accessing the <TECHNOLOGY>Build Menu<> with <IMG>BUILD_MENU<>. The structure of a finalised Corvette can be also <STELLAR>modified<> at the Corvette Workshop at any time.

UI_MP_FISH_DESC_1:
Nada seeks samples of the galaxy's more unusual fish, as they seek to further their understanding of the different ways in which life can manifest.

Catching the creatures is sufficient for the remote monitoring scans to run. They may be released or processed as you please afterwards. Dedicated teams of research-minded anglers are sought for the task.

NPC_MISSION_FISH_PROC_A_4: The client is studying the impact of freighter traffic on local fish populations.

EXPED_15_INTRO:
No Man's Sky <TECHNOLOGY>AQUARIUS<> invites you down to the water to relax, catch fish, and share tall tales...

Featuring a brand-new fishing system, hundreds of fish to track and collect, new customisation options, the community-wide <COMMODITY>Aquarius Expedition<>, and more!
EXPED_15_BULLET1: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Catch, collect and catalogue a vast array of <TECHNOLOGY>fish<>!
EXPED_15_BULLET2: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Explore different <TECHNOLOGY>habitats<> and craft unique <TECHNOLOGY>bait<> to track down each new catch.
EXPED_15_BULLET3: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Deploy the <TECHNOLOGY>Exo-Skiff<> and fish in comfort, whatever the weather.
EXPED_15_BULLET4: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Join the community on a laid-back fishing expedition and earn exclusive nautical customisation options.
EXPED_15_OUTRO:
Hello Games has been hard at work to improve and expand No Man's Sky. We hope you enjoy. :)

More will follow...

UI_FISH_SKIFF_DESC:
A deployable static platform, allowing the user to comfortably survey the seas in any weather. As well as providing a steady and easily accessible fishing spot, the Exo-Skiff also features abundant <TECHNOLOGY>Cold Storage<>, granting additional space to store your catch. 

<STELLAR>Summon<> the Exo-Skiff to any suitable body of water using the Quick Menu (<IMG>QUICK_MENU<>).
UI_FISHLASER_DESC:
A versatile piece of <TECHNOLOGY>angling equipment<>, enabling the user to <STELLAR>fish<> in a variety of water conditions.

Access the fishing rig by pressing <IMG>CYCLEWEAPON<> and cast your line into a body of water with <IMG>ATTACK<>. With a fish hooked, press and hold <IMG>ATTACK<> to haul in your catch.
BLD_SEAHARVESTER_DESC:
An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions.

Once activated, the system will lure and trap any nearby aquatic creatures and store them for later retrieval.
BLD_SEAHARVESTER_DESC_ALT:
An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions. Return later to collect trapped fish.

Trap cycle: <TRADEABLE>IN PROGRESS<>
UI_FISH_ALL_LEG_S_DESC: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."
UI_FISH_ALL_LEG_M_DESC: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."
UI_FISH_ALL_LEG_L_DESC: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."
UI_FISH_ALL_LEG_XL_DESC: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."
UI_FISH_LUSH_LEG_S_DESC: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."
UI_FISH_LUSH_LEG_M_DESC: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."
UI_FISH_LUSH_LEG_L_DESC: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."
UI_FISH_LUSH_LEG_XL_DESC: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."
UI_FISH_HOT_LEG_S_DESC: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."
UI_FISH_HOT_LEG_M_DESC: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."
UI_FISH_HOT_LEG_L_DESC: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."
UI_FISH_HOT_LEG_XL_DESC: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."
UI_FISH_COLD_LEG_S_DESC: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."
UI_FISH_COLD_LEG_M_DESC: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."
UI_FISH_COLD_LEG_L_DESC: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."
UI_FISH_COLD_LEG_XL_DESC: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."
UI_FISH_RAD_LEG_S_DESC: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."
UI_FISH_RAD_LEG_M_DESC: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."
UI_FISH_RAD_LEG_L_DESC: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."
UI_FISH_RAD_LEG_XL_DESC: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."
UI_FISH_TOX_LEG_S_DESC: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."
UI_FISH_TOX_LEG_M_DESC: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."
UI_FISH_TOX_LEG_L_DESC: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."
UI_FISH_TOX_LEG_XL_DESC: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."
UI_FISH_DUST_LEG_S_DESC: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."
UI_FISH_DUST_LEG_M_DESC: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."
UI_FISH_DUST_LEG_L_DESC: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."
UI_FISH_DUST_LEG_XL_DESC: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."
UI_FISH_ODD_LEG_S_DESC: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."
UI_FISH_ODD_LEG_M_DESC: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."
UI_FISH_ODD_LEG_L_DESC: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."
UI_FISH_ODD_LEG_XL_DESC: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."
UI_FISH_RARITY_COM_S_DESC: Abundant in numbers and typically found in shallower water, this is a relatively <TRADEABLE>common<> catch.

UI_EXPED15_SUMMARY: Sign up for Expedition 15: <SPECIAL>Aquarius<> to join the community on an angling adventure of fishing, stories, and the one that got away...
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_DESC:
Join the community on an angling adventure to catch fish, gather stories, and think about the one that got away...

Complete <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<> to earn new equipment. Complete entire <COMMODITY>Phases<> for special, exclusive rewards.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE1B: View progress in the <STELLAR>Expedition<> page (<IMG>OPTIONS<>). Reach the <SPECIAL>Space Anomaly<> to retrieve your stored items.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE2A: Earn <STELLAR>exclusive rewards<> by completing <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<>. Complete milestones in <TRADEABLE>any order<>.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE2B: Earn <STELLAR>exclusive rewards<> by completing <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<>. Complete milestones in <TRADEABLE>any order<>.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE3A: Follow a path through the galaxy to each of the <SPECIAL>Rendezvous Points<> to earn large rewards.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE3B: Bases, discoveries, and other progress <TECHNOLOGY>will be shared or merged<> with your primary save.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE4A: Exclusive expedition rewards can be accessed on <STELLAR>any save<>. This save will remain playable when the expedition ends.
UI_EXPED15_DETAIL_LINE4B: Switch back to your primary save at <STELLAR>any time<>. Exclusive expedition rewards can be accessed on <STELLAR>any save<>.
UI_EXPD_TITLE_15_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Explorer Title<>, commemorating the catches, the stories, and the ones that got away while on the <STELLAR>Aquarius<> expedition.

Apply this title to your banner at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
BLD_DECAL_EXPD_15_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases.

This decal commemorates the catches, the stories, and the ones that got away while on the <STELLAR>Aquarius<> expedition.
UI_BANNER_EXPD_15_DESC:
Equip this exclusive <STELLAR>Personal Flair<> in commemoration of the <STELLAR>Aquarius<> expedition.

Apply this banner to your profile at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
BLD_EXPD_POSTER15A_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art.

This poster celebrates the need to get away from distractions and spend some time on and/or in the water.
BLD_EXPD_POSTER15B_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art.

A poster to help sailors navigate treacherous depths and shifting sands...
BLD_EXPD_POSTER15C_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art.

An educational poster, useful for all those who seek to identify the teeming bounty of the ocean.
UI_EXPED_FISH_ARMOUR_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Exosuit Appearance Override<>.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
UI_EXPED_FISH_PACK_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Exosuit Appearance Override<>.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this jetpack replacement allows for smooth and stylish passage through the murky abyss.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
UI_S15_FISHLASER_DESC:
A versatile piece of <TECHNOLOGY>angling equipment<>, enabling the user to <STELLAR>fish<> in a variety of water conditions. This rig was once owned by the legendary <STELLAR>Lost Angler<>.

Access the fishing rig by pressing <IMG>CYCLEWEAPON<> and cast your line into a body of water with <IMG>ATTACK<>. With a fish hooked, press and hold <IMG>ATTACK<> to haul in your catch.
UI_EXPED_GET_FISHLASER_OBJ_TIP:
To install new technologies, open your inventory (<IMG>INVENTORY<>) and press <IMG>TECHMENU<> on empty slot.

Select an empty <STELLAR>Inventory<> or <TECHNOLOGY>Technology<> slot and begin installation with <IMG>TECHMENU<>. Pin required components with <IMG>PIN<>.

UI_EXPED_CATCH_FISH_OBJ_TIP:
All anglers must first acquire a <TECHNOLOGY>Fishing Rig<>. With the rig installed and active, cast a line into any body of water with <IMG>ATTACK<>.

With the float and line deployed, await a suitable catch. With a fish hooked, press and hold <IMG>ATTACK<> to <STELLAR>haul in your catch<>. Note: attempting to haul in a fish without it properly hooked may result in failure.

View details of your catches, as well as <TECHNOLOGY>specific habitat requirements<> in the <STELLAR>Catalogue<>.

Craft and apply specialist <STELLAR>bait<> or <TECHNOLOGY>lures<> to improve catch chances. Note: any foodstuff may be used as bait if circumstances demand.

UI_S15_SHIPLOG_DESC1:
As I settle into the starship's oddly familiar surroundings, I feel a strange dampness about the seat. The smell of salt water lingers in the air, faint but unmistakable.
Looking closer, there appears to be a bottle lodged into the launch control panel.
UI_S15_SHIPLOG_DESC2: There is a message inside the bottle, scrawled in a hasty hand and torn from a larger book. It reads:
UI_S15_SHIPLOG_LANG:
"I finally feel like I'm getting closer. A trader on Gisto offered me solid-gold information on its location, for a price.
And so I'm selling my ship. I'll miss the <VAL_ON>Celeste<>, but I have to know if the rumours are true. I hope whoever buys you takes good care of you..."
UI_S15_SHIPLOG_DESC3: At the bottom of the message, someone has added a hand-written set of planetary coordinates...
UI_15_FISH_TRASH_BOTTLE_DESC:
A sealed bottle, found floating in the water. There appears to be a message from <STELLAR>the Angler<> inside.

Use <VAL_ON><IMG>FE_ALT1<><> to <STELLAR>unseal<> the bottle and read the message within.
UI_S15_BOTTLED_MESSAGE1_DESC:
A message recovered from a bottle stowed beneath the seat of the starship. It reads:

<VAL_ON>"I finally feel like I'm getting closer. A trader on Gisto offered me solid-gold information on its location, for a price.
And so I'm selling my ship. I'll miss the <VAL_ON>Celeste<>, but I have to know if the rumours are true. I hope whoever buys you takes good care of you..."
%PARTY_1%<>
UI_S15_BOTTLED_MESSAGE2_DESC:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"The rumours were true. It's out there, I can feel it. Not here, but somewhere. The water calls to me, I just need to follow its voice..."
%PARTY_3%<>
UI_S15_BOTTLED_MESSAGE3_DESC:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"I saw it in my dreams last night. Scales like fire and eyes of pure starlight. It sang to me, a song of hope and longing. It wants me to find it, I know it. I must be closing in."
%PARTY_4%<>
UI_S15_BOTTLED_MESSAGE4_DESC:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"I was right! It was here! After all these light years, all the doubts, it's finally mine. Oh, and how it shines! Like fire in the water, beautiful, impossible..."
%PARTY_5%<>
UI_S15_BOTTLED_MESSAGE5_DESC:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"The fire has faded from my catch's scales, and my dreams have soured. I thrash through the night. My skin itches, damp and clammy. Salt seeps from my pores.
It longs to be free. I cannot keep it contained like this. It must be free.
I must be free..."<>
UI_S15_FISH_DESC:
Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away.

The sound of water fills your ears. It wants to be free. You want to be free...
UI_S15_FISH_BOBBLE_DESC:

UI_EXPED_S15_OCTO_OBJ_TIP:

<VAL_ON>"The fire has faded from my catch's scales, and my dreams have soured. I thrash through the night. My skin itches, damp and clammy. Salt seeps from my pores.
It longs to be free. I cannot keep it contained like this. It must be free.
I must be free..."<>

Hello Games has been hard at work to improve and expand No Man's Sky. We hope you enjoy. :)

UI_SQUIDFRAG_DESC:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.

Released upon the destruction of a <SPECIAL>boundary horror<>.

UI_S16_SHIPLOG_LANG: <SPECIAL>You cannot run from this... you cannot hide in the stars forever...<>
UI_S16_SHIPLOG_DESC: The voice hisses through my starship's system, a static snarl that sends shivers down my spine. I wait, but it does not speak again.
UI_S16_SHIPLOG_RES_A: I unplug the starship communicator, but it feels futile. These messages are not broadcast on any normal frequency...
UI_S16_PORTAL_BLOOD_RES: <AUDIO>MUS_Corrupted_Sting_Long<>I daub some of the elixir across the plinth. The stone seems to shiver in response before a voice calls out, resonating from deep within the rock.
UI_S16_PORTAL1_DESC1:
The portal shimmers as I look at it, never quite resting long enough for my eyes to process it fully. I must focus.
I wonder - is the portal a doorway, or a seal? A passage, or a cage? The <FUEL>Elixir of Blood<> opened a way to communicate across the boundary. Will it be the key here too?
UI_S16_PORTAL1_LANG1:
<SPECIAL>i followed them... i had to. you have to. we all would. that's why we here, after all. to discover. to see. to explore.<>
<SPECIAL>and now, it is too late... we will see you soon...<>
<SPECIAL>forgive me...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL2_DESC1:
A warm, dull ache spreads across my mind as I approach the portal. I blink as I try to focus, but all this does is enflame the red glow behind my eyes.
The <FUEL>Elixir of Blood<> has opened a path to whatever lies within the portals, whatever realm lurks beneath our reality. I must go on.
UI_S16_PORTAL2_LANG1:
<SPECIAL>have you seen it yet?<>
<SPECIAL>you have seen us... we have seen you... we are all together now...<>
<SPECIAL>...together in the void beyond...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL2_RES_A:
<SPECIAL>some of you know... you are not the only one... you all see, in the end, that you are not alone...<>
<SPECIAL>and we?<>
<SPECIAL>we are closer than you think...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL2_RES_B:
<SPECIAL>come, silent one... join us now...<>
<SPECIAL>we are closer than you think...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL3_DESC1:
I see the stone of the portal, its immovable muted silver. And yet something lurks beneath. It is grey and yet not grey, a crimson calling out from somewhere below its cool surface.
I see no other way forward. I must push on, through the <FUEL>blood<>, through the <STELLAR>portal<>, through the <SPECIAL>glass<>...
UI_S16_PORTAL3_LANG1:
<SPECIAL>do you remember which you are? where you belong? can you see where you came from?<>
<SPECIAL>do you remember?<>
<SPECIAL>is it first? is it last?<>
UI_S16_PORTAL3_RES_A: The voice only laughs in response. The sound chills me.
UI_S16_PORTAL3_RES_B: The voice only laughs in response. The sound chills me.
UI_S16_PORTAL4_DESC1:
As I stand before the portal, my breath feels hot within my lungs, a burning red deep within my chest. My exosuit is functioning correctly, and reports everything to be normal. And yet that is not how I feel.
I do not know where I am. I do not know where I have come from. I cannot stay here, and so I must go on. I must offer <FUEL>myself<> to the <SPECIAL>portal<> once more.
UI_S16_PORTAL4_LANG1:
<SPECIAL>we think you understand now... you do not remember your time beyond the boundary, but you understand it...<>
<SPECIAL>deep within, you understand. the mind forgets, but the memory lingers...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL4_RES_A: <SPECIAL>your journey ends here... your journey starts here...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL4_RES_B: <SPECIAL>you cannot leave us now... there is nothing behind you... there is nowhere to run...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL5_DESC1:
I close my eyes as I approach the portal, and when I open them again I half expect the structure to be gone. But there it is, as real as anything else I've seen.
I struggle to recall the start of my journey. How did I get here? Where did I come from? All I remember is the <SPECIAL>portal<> and the <FUEL>blood<>. It must be the way forward...
UI_S16_PORTAL5_LANG1: <SPECIAL>this world is an illusion... the boundary is an illusion.... discord and harmony, crimson and glass, it is all the same - and it is all melting...<>
UI_S16_PORTAL5_RES_A:
I see a vision, <DELAY>0.5<>a red star and a fragile world. I do not understand the shapes within, the whispers, the seeds of glass...

I see lifeforms scattered to the far reaches of the galaxies. I see a stranger's first breath, yearning for the stars. I see myself, slumbering in the void, waiting for a dream of worlds...
UI_S16_PORTAL5_RES_B: <SPECIAL>you cannot leave... you are already here...<>
UI_S16_CAVEGRAVE_LANG2:
<SPECIAL>i have been<> – <AUDIO>TXT_RadioNoise<><STELLAR>kzzkt<> – <SPECIAL>we have been here the whole time<>
<SPECIAL>i am them... they are me... you are one of us too...<>
UI_S16_CAVEGRAVE_LANG3:
<SPECIAL>we all sing together.... every voice a different chord of the same music...<>
<SPECIAL>the boundaries melt... the singularity is coming...<>
UI_S16_CAVEGRAVE_LANG4:
<SPECIAL>you know where you have been, even if you cannot remember it... the atlas knows where we have been, even if it cannot see it...<>
<SPECIAL>it will not forgive our excursion...<>
UI_S16_CAVEGRAVE_RES: <AUDIO>TXT_RadioNoise<><SPECIAL>kzttzkt<> – <SPECIAL>i should not have drunk the water<> – <AUDIO>TXT_RadioNoise<><SPECIAL>kzttzkt<> –

UI_S16_ABAND_DESC1:
I approach the terminal on autopilot, almost as if my Exosuit remembers being here before. The whole building feels like a place out of time, a fragment of another world...
There are marks in the dust that lays thickly on the terminal, the trace of an imprint on its glassy surface. As I lean in to examine it, <TECHNOLOGY>a voice<> hisses from within.
UI_S16_ABAND_LANG1: <SPECIAL>we swim where the crimson eye cannot see... we swim where you long to be... the glass calls to you... it always calls to you...<>
UI_S16_ABAND_RES_A: <SPECIAL>no-one will hear you... no-one but us...<>
UI_S16_ABAND_RES_B: I snatch my hand back from the terminal, expecting the worst. But there is no other message, no sound but static.

UI_EXPED17_MAIN_DESC: Join the Titan Expedition on a voyage through a dazzling array of new worlds and new stars...
UI_EXPED17_SUMMARY: Sign up for Expedition 17: <STELLAR>Titan<> to undertake a voyage through a dazzling array of new worlds and new stars...
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_DESC:
Join the community on an adventure of exploration across the universe, a voyage to chart a dazzling array of new stars and new worlds.

Complete <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<> to earn new equipment. Complete entire <COMMODITY>Phases<> for special, exclusive rewards.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE1B: View progress in the <STELLAR>Expedition<> page (<IMG>OPTIONS<>). Reach the <SPECIAL>Space Anomaly<> to retrieve your stored items.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE2A: Earn <STELLAR>exclusive rewards<> by completing <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<>. Complete milestones in <TRADEABLE>any order<>.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE2B: Earn <STELLAR>exclusive rewards<> by completing <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<>. Complete milestones in <TRADEABLE>any order<>.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE3A: Follow a path through the galaxy to each of the <SPECIAL>Rendezvous Points<> to earn large rewards.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE3B: Bases, discoveries, and other progress <TECHNOLOGY>will be shared or merged<> with your primary save.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE4A: Exclusive expedition rewards can be accessed on <STELLAR>any save<>. This save will remain playable when the expedition ends.
UI_EXPED17_DETAIL_LINE4B: Switch back to your primary save at <STELLAR>any time<>. Exclusive expedition rewards can be accessed on <STELLAR>any save<>.
UI_EXPD_TITLE_17_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Explorer Title<>, marking the <STELLAR>Titan<> expedition's voyage through new stars and new worlds.

Apply this title to your banner at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
BLD_DECAL_EXPD_17_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases.

This decal marks the <STELLAR>Titan<> expedition's voyage through new stars and new worlds.

Equip this exclusive <STELLAR>Personal Flair<> in commemoration of the <STELLAR>Titan<> expedition.

UI_EXPD_SHIPMAT_17_DESC:
An exclusive starship customisation option, creating a vibrant and eye-catching appearance for <STELLAR>Fighter<> and <STELLAR>Hauler<> class starships.

Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the <TECHNOLOGY>Starship Outfitting<> unit aboard any space station. Visit the <TECHNOLOGY>Starship Fabricator<> to design and assemble a new vessel.
UI_EXPED_STAFF_17_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Multi-Tool<>.

This sturdy staff is hewn from polished stone, and yet floats in the hand as if it were no weight at all. It is a perfect companion to those who seek to make long trips across the wilderness.

<STELLAR>Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or <STELLAR>Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (<IMG>QUICK_MENU<>).
UI_CAPE_S17_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Exosuit Appearance Override<>.

A robust and well-made covering: waterproof, windproof and designed to keep the wearer protected against anything they may encounter while exploring unmapped worlds.
Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
UI_EXPD_SHIP_17_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>starship<>, earned for surveying a host of new worlds during the <STELLAR>Titan Expedition<>.

<STELLAR>Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or <STELLAR>Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (<IMG>QUICK_MENU<>).

This poster shows the titanic form of a <SPECIAL>gas giant<> and its surrounding moons.

UI_EXPED18_MAIN_DESC: Join the Relics Expedition to unearth ancient treasures and recreate the lost beasts of the past...
UI_EXPED18_SUMMARY: Sign up for Expedition 18: <STELLAR>Relics<> to unearth ancient treasures and recreate the lost beasts of the past...
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_DESC:
Sign up with the <STELLAR>Galactic Palaeology Society<> and join the community on a journey to recreate ancient lifeforms and uncover secrets left undisturbed for millennia.

Complete <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<> to earn new equipment. Complete entire <COMMODITY>Phases<> for special, exclusive rewards.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE1B: View progress in the <STELLAR>Expedition<> page (<IMG>OPTIONS<>). Reach the <SPECIAL>Space Anomaly<> to retrieve your stored items.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE2A: Earn <STELLAR>exclusive rewards<> by completing <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<>. Complete milestones in <TRADEABLE>any order<>.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE2B: Earn <STELLAR>exclusive rewards<> by completing <TECHNOLOGY>Milestones<>. Complete milestones in <TRADEABLE>any order<>.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE3A: Follow a path through the galaxy to each of the <SPECIAL>GPS dig sites<> to earn large rewards.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE3B: Bases, discoveries, and other progress <TECHNOLOGY>will be shared or merged<> with your primary save.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE4A: Exclusive expedition rewards can be accessed on <STELLAR>any save<>. This save will remain playable when the expedition ends.
UI_EXPED18_DETAIL_LINE4B: Switch back to your primary save at <STELLAR>any time<>. Exclusive expedition rewards can be accessed on <STELLAR>any save<>.
UI_EXPD_TITLE_18_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Explorer Title<>, marking the <STELLAR>Relics<> expedition's voyage through new stars and new worlds.

Apply this title to your banner at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
BLD_DECAL_EXPD_18_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases.

This decal marks the <STELLAR>Relics<> expedition's voyage of discovery and the recreation of the lost beasts of the past.
UI_BANNER_EXPD_18_DESC:
Equip this exclusive <STELLAR>Personal Flair<> in commemoration of the <STELLAR>Relics<> expedition.

BLD_EXPD_POSTER18A_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art.

A poster for those that want to celebrate creatures not bound to solid ground.
BLD_EXPD_POSTER18B_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art.

A lovely catalogue of different skulls, in case you need a reference.
BLD_EXPD_POSTER18C_DESCRIPTION:
An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art.

Show off the simplicity of nature with these attractive shells.
UI_EXPED_STAFF_18_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Multi-Tool<>.

The skull of an ancient beast sits atop this fused pillar of bone and circuitry. Beware its gaze...

<STELLAR>Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or <STELLAR>Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (<IMG>QUICK_MENU<>).
UI_EXPED_STONE_ARMOUR_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Exosuit Appearance Override<>.

A powerful magnetic field runs through this ancient stone, turning lumpen rock into something almost alive. The carver of this effigy is unknown.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
UI_EXPED_STONE_PACK_DESC:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Exosuit Appearance Override<>.

An unusual alternative to the traditional jetpack, this flight device is sculpted from the remains of sentient rock. Magmatic gases provide the hardpack's thrust, while an anti-gravity field supports the weight of the stone, ensuring ergonomic safety for the user.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an <TECHNOLOGY>Appearance Modifier<>.
UI_EXPD_EGG_18_DESC:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A foetal creature of bone grows inside, its delicate body suspended in vitellus. Its fleshless limbs are comprised of soft cartilage, which will harden and densify as it grows. 

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <SPECIAL>skeletal<> and <STELLAR>elephantine<>.
UI_EXPED18_START_MSG1:
Locate and board your starship
Use the <TECHNOLOGY>Compass<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<> to navigate
UI_EXPED18_COMMS_DESC: The ship communicator registers an incoming message. The frequency is unusual, broadcast on an antiquated bandwidth, but the signature is identifiable: the "<STELLAR>Galactic Palaeology Society<>".
DNT_EXPED18_COMMS2_LANG: Hello Friend! We are fossil specialist business. Bring exciting opportunity! Collect artifacts! Collect bones! Be partner! Earn big money!
UI_EXPED18_COMMS2_DESC:
The alien babbles enthusiastically, not seeming to mind whether the specifics of their words are understood. Dust floats from their hands as they gesticulate.
Attached to the transmission are details of an excavation schedule, plotting out a series of dig sites spread across multiple worlds. A collection of valuable relics are listed, offered as reward for participating explorers.
UI_EXPED18_COMMS2_RES:
The Galactic Palaeology Society representative appears delighted.
The first directive on the schedule is not a request for fossils, as I had expected, but a request for artifacts. Perhaps this first phase is a test, a measure of my excavatory skills.

UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE_DESC2: The <STELLAR>Galactic Palaeology Society<> agent catches my eye as they dust themselves off.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE_LANG: Ah! You are new worker, yes? Very good! Many of you coming here. So, friend, do you have anything for us?
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE_RES: The alien smiles approvingly. They gently push the artifact back toward me. It is mine to keep.
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_DESC: Report to the second GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_DESC_D: Reported to the second GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_OBJ: Report to the Galactic Palaeology Society's second dig site
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_DESC2: The palaeontologist wipes a film of moisture from their forehead.<NEWLINE>They are evidently excited to see me.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_LANG:
Welcome, new worker friend! At this site, we research creatures with two legs.
Gratitude for any help friend can offer. Construct bones, create complete fossil. Teach us how ancient creatures walk!
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_DESC2_B: The palaeontologist shows me a sketch of a bipedal creature. The drawing is imaginatively rendered, with loving attention to detail. The request is clear: make this creature real by reconstructing its fossil.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE2_RES: Excellent! We await your best two legs fossil!
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_DESC: Report to the third GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_DESC_D: Reported to the third GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_OBJ: Report to the Galactic Palaeology Society's third dig site
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_DESC2: I overhear the palaeontologist conversing with a remote colleague. They seem to be discussing some of their findings, their tone puzzled.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_LANG: ...do not understand what has become of these ancient creatures. The fauna here has no evidence of four legs.
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_DESC3:
The alien turns their attention to me, indicating a diagram on their datapad. A quadrupedal beast is displayed. They tap at the four limbs, shaking their head and frowning.
%NAME% seems to want me to find evidence of this four-legged creature - or one of its descendants.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_LANG2: It is very strange, friend. The bones we have found are so different from the creatures today. The ancestor has four legs. Fauna now has none! Can you help us learn more?
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE3_RES: Thank you, friend! Your work has already been excellent! Please scan the fauna of this world. Find us our four legs!
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_DESC: Report to the fourth GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_DESC_D: Reported to the fourth GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_OBJ: Report to the Galactic Palaeology Society's fourth dig site
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_DESC2: The palaeontologist's attention is held by an image of a scaly creature on their datapad. They jab excitedly at the screen, and then turn their attention towards me.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_LANG: Oh, friend. How I wish to see a complete fossil. I love simple water creatures like this. Just look at it! You would be best friend if you can find these bones.
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_DESC2B: %NAME% seems to want me to recruit me for their project - and this reptilian creature appears to be their aim.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE4_RES: There is no water here now, but I believe this world was rich with water creatures in the past! Please, friend, look for bones! Show supervisor I am not idiot!
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_DESC: Report to the final GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_DESC_D: Reported to the final GPS dig
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_OBJ: Report to the Galactic Palaeology Society's final dig site
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_DESC2: Gesturing at their data-pad, the palaeontologist twists together a trio of holographic helixes and starts a sequencing algorithm.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_LANG: Other site friends have been in contact. Said very good things about you. Excellent skills! At this site, we seek the most important fossil. You are ready for this test!
UI_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_DESC2_B: %NAME% babbles excitedly, attempting to make themselves clear. Waving their datapad, they gesture at me, at themselves, and at the skies around us.
DNT_EXPED18_DIG_SITE5_RES: It is a question of who we are, friend! We seek bones of the ancient Gek ancestor, before the First Spawn.
UI_EXPED18_BONEFISH_OBJ: Catch a Whispering or Bleached Bonefish
UI_EXPED18_BONEFISH_OBJ_TIP:
<SPECIAL>Bleached Bonefish<> can be found in deep water on <STELLAR>Toxic<> worlds. <SPECIAL>Whispering Bonefish<> may be found in any deep water at night.

All anglers must first acquire a <TECHNOLOGY>Fishing Rig<>. With the rig installed and active, cast a line into any body of water with <IMG>ATTACK<>.

Craft and apply specialist <STELLAR>bait<> or <TECHNOLOGY>lures<> to improve catch chances. Note: any foodstuff may be used as bait if circumstances demand.

UI_STONE_EYE_PROD_DESC:
An eye of living stone: waiting, watching. A relic left by a slumbering guardian, keeping sentry over ancient creature burial grounds.

<FUEL>Warning<>: Disturbing the eye may disturb the slumber of <SPECIAL>living stone guardians<>. Ensure re-animated guardians are defeated before storing this relic in the home.
UI_GUIDE_BODY_BONES:
Some worlds are rich in <STELLAR>fossil beds<>. Travellers can exhume the <STELLAR>ancient bones<> of long-extinct creatures for collection, preservation, and display.

To assemble a fossil, first acquire the blueprints for a <TECHNOLOGY>Fossil Display<> from the <TECHNOLOGY>Construction Research Station<> aboard the <SPECIAL>Space Anomaly<>. A <TECHNOLOGY>Fossil Display<> can be deployed anywhere on a planetary surface, or within a freighter base.

Once a display is deployed, <STELLAR>ancient bones<> can be arranged upon it to re-create countless animal forms. A complete fossil requires a <STELLAR>skull<>, a <STELLAR>ribcage<>, two sets of <STELLAR>limbs<>, and a <STELLAR>tail<>.

Create a museum of assembled fossils at your base, or <STELLAR>package<> your exhibits for trade on the open market, or with other Travellers. Find alien <STELLAR>Fossil Collectors<> to trade with aboard <STELLAR>Space Stations<>, or at planetary <STELLAR>Palaeontological Digs<>.

UI_FOS_DESC_PRED_14: Unrestricted by fears of lesser beasts
UI_FOS_DESC_PRED_19: Gripped by a thirst for blood
UI_FOS_DESC_HERB_9: Always in search of new plantlife
UI_FOS_DESC_HERB_12: As part of a great herd
UI_FOS_DESC_HERB_13: Forever in search of fresh vegetation
UI_FOS_DESC_HERB_14: Surviving on a diet of fruit
UI_FOS_DESC_HERB_17: Fuelled by a diet of leaves and grasses
UI_FOS_DESC_OMNI_6: Slurping down whatever food it could find
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_A_1: These bones are deeply pitted, gnawed upon by gargantuan carnivore teeth - postmortem, or in life
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_A_2: This creature was once a bulky fighter, ferocious to the last. The jawbone is distorted, wrenched from its joint by a violent swipe
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_A_3: Evolved binocular vision allowed this creature to project its sight several units in front of it, instinctively and precisely calculating the trajectory of moving objects
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_A_4: Multiple layers of incisors are sheathed within one another, extending and retracting to rend at flesh
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_A_5: Cavernous internal ears detected the softest of footsteps, but amplified the despair of the creature's prey, haunting this beast to madness
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_B_1: The bones are corroded, as though this specimen is partially digested. Fused to the skull are deposits of minerals, chewed %ITEM%, and other archetypal examples of megafauna diet
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_B_2: This creature's peripheral vision stretched to a 390° field of view, providing superior movement detection and a perplexing afterimage of its own eyeballs
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_B_3: A nervous creature, it nipped at nutritious flora, perceived threats, and space-time anomalies with its protruding front teeth
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_B_4: Evidence of nesting behaviour indicates a highly social creature. Affectionate and doting, it raised its young in subterranean nesting colonies
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_B_5: The bones are gelatinous: an advantage in wriggling through tight gaps, but also made this creature a prized snack for predatory carnivores
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_C_1: Scans of the dentine reveal that this creature's front incisors once extended to an impressive 1.%NUM_SMALL%u
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_C_2: This creature lived to a grand and imposing age, eventually succumbing to starvation when its ground-thin mandible could grind no more
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_C_3: Attracted to unusual artifacts, this creature would construct elaborate nests lined with %ITEM% to impress potential mates
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_C_4: This creature relied upon a symbiotic relationship with a local species of flora. The plant rooted in its very skeleton and grew along the veins and sinew, releasing spores to disorient predators
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_C_5: The fossil has a large abdominal cavity; in life, this creature had an incredible uterine capacity. To compensate for a high infant mortality rate, it would give birth to litters of up to %NUM_LARGE% young
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_D_1: This creature mapped its environment by scent, sniffing out its surroundings with its long, narrow nasal cavity
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_D_2: The bones are stained a faint %COLOUR% from the creature's brightly-coloured blood
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_D_3: This creature was enamoured with its own appearance, sometimes falling into bodies of water while admiring its visage. It elected to reproduce asexually
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_D_4: This intelligent beast had an excellent memory, capable of memorising sequences of up to %NUM_LARGE% elements
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_D_5: An inquitisitve and courageous beast, with exceptional colour vision. It explored every corner of its environment, snuffling for %COLOUR% objects to play with
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_E_1: Elongated snout bones once contained a spiralling nasal cavity, branching into an olfactory labyrinth of %NUM_LARGE% sensory receptors
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_E_2: The creature's neural processing appears to have been distributed throughout its entire body. Multiple clusters of neurons added up to approximately %NUM_LARGE% thinking cores operating in parallel
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_E_3: The cranium is partitioned to house %NUM_SMALL% individual brains, each expressing a distinct personality
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_E_4: A magnetic skeleton helped this creature sense the location of nearby terrain deposits. It appears to have supplemented its diet with shavings of various metals
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_E_5: The creature's extraordinary nose enabled it to smell colours. It preferred %COLOUR% objects, hunting and burying them for safekeeping
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_F_1: The curves of the skull suggest an abundance of soft facial tissue. Though now stripped away by decay, in life this creature could beguile any would-be predators with its gentle, smiling face
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_F_2: The flesh of this creature was once plump and buoyant. Although semi-aquatic in nature, it had an innate fear of deep water, wallowing only in the shallows
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_F_3: In life, this creature's broad snout benefited from extendible, prehensile nostrils, which allowed the beast to lurk underwater almost indefinitely
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_F_4: This amphibious beast once patrolled the ocean floor, its dense bones helping anchor it against floatation. There is evidence that at low tide, it would not just walk, but dance upon the seabed - though the specifics of this strange ritual are lost to time
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_F_5: This creature habitually reshaped its body in life, morphing into situationally advantageous formats. These bones, threaded with an unusually high count of arteries, have been shattered and regrown many times over
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_G_1: The cranial vault is enlarged, suggesting a highly advanced brain. The creature had evolved a vocabulary of approximately %NUM_LARGE% words, with more than a quarter describing acts of violence
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_G_2: This specimen is a fascinating example of a genetic mutation, the creature's brain swollen out of all proportion to its face
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_G_3: Within the skull is a secondary inner skull, which insulated the living creature's brain to preserve perfect, uninterrupted homeostasis
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_G_4: These bones have an unsettling quality to them. From the corner of the eye, they appear to quiver, almost lurch - though they are quite stationary when examined directly
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_G_5: Traces of %ITEM% are embedded in the upper limbs, as though this creature was tightly gripping this prized possession at the moment of death
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_H_1: Bulges and distortions along the creature's skeleton indicate the wending passage of its digestive tract. Traces of mangled %ITEM% are still wedged between two ribs
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_H_2: In life, this creature could dislocate its jaw to swallow prey of up to 1.%NUM_SMALL%u in diameter
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_H_3: In life, this creature radiated a haunting glow. The bones are warm to the touch, residue from radioactive marrow still present
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_H_4: Although tragically young when it perished, surviving only %NUM_LARGE% days, this creature was self-sufficient from birth. It was capable of sourcing its own food and shelter from infancy, and ultimately lived a full - though abbreviated - life
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_H_5: Sections of these bones are curiously smooth, where they once protruded beyond the living creature's flesh. A lifetime of lurking in sand dunes has polished the vertebrae to a shine
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_I_1: This creature used its beak as a primitive but effective multi-tool for prising open containers and thieving lost %ITEM%. The keratin has repeatedly healed around cracks and chips
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_I_2: The creature's large, soulful eyes were supported by bony rings in the sockets. Its hypnotic gaze enabled it to mimic and deceive predators
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_I_3: The eyesockets are worn from the rapid twitching of its beady eyes, which it vibrated rhythmically to attract a mate
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_I_4: The throat bones are arranged in a lyre-like formation, providing an acoustic shell for its complex vocal mesh
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_I_5: In life, the voice of this creature reverberated through a series of chest cavities, generating echoes upon echoes before the song left its beak
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_J_1: The pronounced ridges on the jaw indicate a tremendous bite force, capable of snapping bone clean through
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_J_2: Isotopic analysis reveals this creature hibernated during the summer, and was flooded with steroid hormones in the winter, when it would seek out and consume dormant prey
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_J_3: A lethally efficient machine, this creature's cranial vault is tight and streamlined. In life, its every process was optimised for the kill
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_J_4: This creature's elongated mouth once contained a matrix of %NUM_LARGE% auditory receptors. It would hinge its jaw open and wait, listening for the approach of a potential meal
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_J_5: Powerful in life, this creature could endure prolonged secretion of lactic acids without damage to its flesh or skeleton. The bones have a pH of 13.%NUM_SMALL%, and are dusted with calcium salts
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_K_1: Tough, keratin-strengthened bone spurs provided the creature with a natural weapon. Excess weight upon the cranium caused chronic vertigo
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_K_2: This specimen was most likely the leader of its herd, having battled its way to supremacy. A gluey, opalescent substance has bubbled up to heal numerous cracks in the skull
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_K_3: Traces of low-frequency electromagnetic waves are present in the creature's tarsal bones, which once provided an advanced system of inter-species communication
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_K_4: In life, these bones would shift between %NUM_SMALL% different colours, synchronised with the creature's fluctuating camoflague. Only in death has the skeleton settled to a neutral ivory
UI_FOS_DESC_HEAD_K_5: The tailbone is detachable, and once formed the spine for peripheral sensory organs. The creature could shed its tail voluntarily, and use it to scout hazardous terrain

UPDATE_20_TITLE: No Man's Sky version 5.5: WORLDS PART II
UPDATE_20_INTRO: No Man's Sky <STELLAR>WORLDS II<> follows on from the first WORLDS update with new star systems, new planets, new gameplay, more variety and more engine enhancements. For full details please see <VAL_ON>www.nomanssky.com<>.
UPDATE_20_BULLET1: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Follow an epic story to create brand new star systems, adding even more variety to the universe.
UPDATE_20_BULLET2: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Engine enhancements include new terrain generation, improved water rendering, and a total overhaul of lighting systems.
UPDATE_20_BULLET3: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Worlds are more varied than ever, and are populated with a vast array of strange new creatures.
UPDATE_20_BULLET4: <IMG>BULLETPOINT<> Entirely new planet classes have been added, including gas giants, water worlds, and ruined civilisations.
UPDATE_20_OUTRO:
Hello Games has been hard at work to improve and expand No Man's Sky. We hope you enjoy. More will follow...

Thank you so much,
Hello Games

UI_PURPM_BOAT_DESC: The object before me appears to be a sort of ship, thrown together from scrap metal and shards of Atlantideum. It moves with a pulse-like rhythm.
UI_PURPM_BOAT3A_LANG: I - <STELLAR>kzzzttzk<> - see. Yes. Your signal - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - is clearer now, prebuilt-Entity.
UI_PURPM_BOAT3B_LANG: An - <STELLAR>kzzzttzk<> - interesting perspective. Telamon-entity would agree. But your signal - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - is clearer now. I see you are a prebuilt-Entity.
UI_PURPM_BOAT3C_LANG: Do not - <STELLAR>kzzzttzk<> - let it trouble you. Your signal - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - is clearer now.<NEWLINE>I perceive you are a prebuilt-Entity.
UI_PURPM_BOAT4A_DESC: The voice is silent a moment, before responding simply:
UI_PURPM_BOAT4B_DESC: The voice makes a sound like laughter.
UI_PURPM_BOAT4B_LANG2:
I understand. My shell - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - does resemble a ship.
Like any - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - Autophage, I salvaged and built this body.<NEWLINE>I simply required a shell that could fly.
I built myself not long after Korvax Prime was destroyed.<NEWLINE>Speed was - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - critical.
UI_PURPM_BOAT5_LANG: And you? I think: yes. I have located the correct prebuilt-Entity.<NEWLINE>You - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - are the disruptor.
UI_PURPM_BOAT5_OPT_B: Say you are not the disruptor
UI_PURPM_BOAT5_RES_B: The Autophage makes a dismissive noise.
UI_PURPM_BOAT6_LANG: It is evident. Your - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - frequency is unconventional.<NEWLINE>You wear a Telamon-entity. And you are free.
UI_PURPM_BOAT6_LANG2:
I have not hailed you without reason. And I - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - do not wish to waste time: mine or yours. I will make my query direct.
Have you seen beyond the - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - crimson?
UI_PURPM_BOAT6_OPT_A: Say you have seen the Atlas
UI_PURPM_BOAT7A_LANG: Yes? You have seen within the  - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - interface, disruptor?<NEWLINE>Then you know: Atlas is more than Korvax mythology.
UI_PURPM_BOAT7B_LANG:
No? You do not wish to say. But I calculate: you recognise my words. You have been admitted to the - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - crimson.
Many Autophage think "Atlas" is - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - indulgent Korvax mythology. But Autophage are not Korvax. Our minds are distinct. My mind is my own.
I have determined - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - Atlas exists. That it favours the disruptor.
UI_PURPM_BOAT7_DESC_STAR: I feel something blaze in my suit. As though the Atlas is asserting its existence through this fragment, my <TECHNOLOGY>Star Seed<> is glowing hot.
UI_PURPM_BOAT7_DESC_DENY: I feel something blaze in my suit. As though the Atlas is asserting its existence through this fragment, my <TECHNOLOGY>Mark of the Denier<> is glowing hot.
UI_PURPM_BOAT7_RES_A: Yes! This is from - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - Atlas? A spark? A seed!
UI_PURPM_BOAT7_RES_C: The Autophage is silent a moment, considering.
UI_PURPM_BOAT8_LANG:
I am - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - old, disruptor. I have been flying a long time. I have seen the interface stations. The diamonds in the dark.
I trust my observations and my calculations. You can interface with Atlas. You can - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - rebuild her.
UI_PURPM_BOAT8_DESC: The voice suddenly takes on a new intensity. Its energy is palpable, sparking across the relay:
UI_PURPM_BOAT8_LANG2: What do you know of the void? Our Autophage progenitor?<NEWLINE>Our  - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - Atlantid?
UI_PURPM_BOAT9_DESC: The strange ship seems to examine my offering with approval.
UI_PURPM_BOAT9_LANG:
Yes. Proof - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - of her return. Her physical manifestation.
I pity the remains of the - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - convergence. Their grief limits them. Her disconnection has reduced them to a single, fragile mind.
Autophage are no longer Korvax. We - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - do not need to grieve.<NEWLINE>We know she is not gone. 
She is spreading. Growing - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - beneath the surface. But the walls of glass are thick. She needs just one seed. And one scaffold.
UI_PURPM_BOAT9B_DESC: The Autophage waits. The communicator softly crackles.
UI_PURPM_BOAT9B_RES_B: The voice finally breaks the silence, with the faintest hint of disappointment.
UI_PURPM_BOAT9B_RES_C: I - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - understood you had seen her for yourself.
UI_PURPM_BOAT10_LANG:
Observe the crystals in my body. Atlantideum.<NEWLINE>It is proof - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - of her physical manifestation.
She still - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - exists. The heart of Korvax Prime.<NEWLINE>Disconnection is not equivalent to erasure.
I pity what remains of the - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - convergence. Their grief limits them. Her disconnection has reduced them to a single, fragile mind.
Autophage are no longer Korvax. We - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - do not need to grieve.<NEWLINE>We know she is not gone. 
She is spreading. Growing - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - beneath the surface. But the walls of glass are thick. She needs just one seed. And one scaffold.
UI_PURPM_BOAT10_OPT_B: Ask what this has to do with you
UI_PURPM_BOAT11_LANG:
I am ignited by - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - possibility, and have not been sufficiently direct. I wish to request your help.
This is an opportunity to restore what was lost - %SIGNAL_GREEK% -  so long ago.<NEWLINE>We have all we need. Atlantideum. Your anomalous signal. Atlas.<NEWLINE>All that remains is assembly.
UI_PURPM_BOAT11_RES_A_STAR: I have not seen - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - Atlas. I cannot enter its crimson diamonds.<NEWLINE>But I have seen the evidence of your spark-seed. Atlas has accepted your input before. This could be the scaffold.
UI_PURPM_BOAT11_RES_A_DENY: I have not seen - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - Atlas. I cannot enter its crimson diamonds.<NEWLINE>But I have seen the evidence of your mark. You have defied Atlas before. This could be the scaffold.
UI_PURPM_BOAT11_RES_A_SILENT: I have not seen Atlas. I cannot enter its crimson diamonds.<NEWLINE>But you - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - you can, disruptor. Atlas could be the scaffold.
UI_PURPM_BOAT12A_LANG:
If you would help us, disruptor, search for what was lost in the ruins of Atlantid. Scan for what your eyes cannot see. Compile a - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - seed.
Atlas will - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - respond. It will not have forgotten her data.
She will - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - return: in stellar multitudes.
UI_PURPM_BOAT12B_LANG: I believed - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - you would help, disruptor.
UI_PURPM_BOAT12B_DESC: There is a warmth in the metallic voice.
UI_PURPM_BOAT12B_LANG2:
Search the dissonant planets. Scan for what your eyes cannot see. Compile a - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - seed.
Atlas will - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - respond. It will not have forgotten her data.
She will - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - return: in stellar multitudes.

UI_PURPM1_BOAT_LANG2: You have the - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - data? The seed?
UI_PURPM1_BOAT_RES_A: This is - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - well compiled.<NEWLINE>An echo of what was. Of what could have been. Of <SPECIAL>her<>.
UI_PURPM1_BOAT2_LANG:
Disruptor, this seed - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - can grow a new prime.
And then - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - more - <STELLAR>kzzzt<> - trillions - <STELLAR>kztkzt<> -<NEWLINE>across the leylines - <STELLAR>kkzzkktkkk<> -
UI_PURPM1_BOAT2_DESC: For a time, the voice is consumed by static. When the signal finally stabilises, the Autophage is mid-sentence:
UI_PURPM1_BOAT2_LANG2: - <STELLAR>kzkkzt<> - components. - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - The scaffold, and the backdoor.
UI_PURPM1_BOAT3B_LANG:
To accelerate her manifestation, the crystal-lattice requires - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - a scaffold.
Atlas is the optimal scaffold. Unlimited access.<NEWLINE>The route - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - to her reconnection.
UI_PURPM1_BOAT3C_LANG:
That is you - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - disruptor.
Atlas favours you. Grants you audience. You are - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - its flaw.<NEWLINE>A backdoor to the architecture of reality.
UI_PURPM1_BOAT4_LANG: Plant the seed discreetly. To grow a memory is a - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - subtle act.
UI_PURPM1_BOAT4_LANG2:

UI_PURPM1_ATLAS2_DESC:
The interface begins to shut down, extinguishing the lights of its terminal line by line. The hum of the machine falls silent.
Only a single source of light remains on the screen, a string of characters blinking against the darkness:
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS4_DESC: A thousand voices cry out at once as the screen re-ignites, awash with colour. The terminal has become a kaleidoscope of images, endless memories streaming from the data packet and into the interface.
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS4_LANG:
[ where are - %SIGNAL_GREEK% ] [ is this - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - real? ] <NEWLINE>[ can - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - you hear us? ]
[ <SPECIAL>...<> ] <AUDIO>TXT_CorruptAtlasPulse<>
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS4_LANG2: [ INTERFACE SIDELOAD COMPLETE ]<NEWLINE>[ GENERATION ACCESS GRANTED ]<NEWLINE>[ MEMORY PAYLOADS - %SIGNAL_GREEK% - PREPARED ]
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS4_DESC2: The terminal continues to overflow with images, fragments dancing between the Atlas and the packet I assembled. Each of these countless memories is its own reality, carrying the fingerprint of a galaxy of lives.
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS4_LANG4: [ ALL CORE PAYLOAD MEMORIES DEFINED ]<NEWLINE>[ TIMELINE MERGE #4924G<>: <STELLAR>VIABLE<> ]
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS5_TITLE: [ PAYLOAD α: THE MEMORIES OF LIFE ]
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS5_DESC: The data on the terminal shifts, suddenly focused. As the images slow, they become more clear. I feel them stretch from the screen and begin to wrap themselves around my own mind...
UI_PURPM1_TRAD_DESC:
I find myself within a busy space station, bustling with vendors and traders.
A passing merchant clicks their beak at me.<NEWLINE>I suppress a compulsion to obey.
UI_PURPM1_WAR_DESC:
My surroundings shift. I am docked in an orbital station, filled with hulking organic lifeforms.
The Vy'keen howl greetings to one other, their voices deep and booming. I observe their tendrilled mouths with fascination.
UI_PURPM1_EXP_DESC:
My mind splits. I am billions of entities, minds interlinked. Harmony through insignificance.
We are the Convergence. Knowledge and enlightenment forever ascending, through the infinite cycle of echo and shell.
UI_PURPM1_EMPTY_DESC:
The Atlas interface fades away. I gaze across empty skies, empty plains, unmarked by the constructs of civilization.
No-one has claimed this system. Its worlds are wild and unspoiled.
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS6_TITLE: [ PAYLOAD β: THE MEMORIES OF WORLDS ]
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS6_DESC: Another set of memories pulsates across the screen. As I watch, I feel their echoed lives begin to resonate within my skull...
UI_PURPM1_GAS_DESC:
I brace myself: our ship has been seized by the atmosphere of a monumental planet. The gravity and pressure here is immense.
This almighty body is a gas giant. Storms rage all around me, larger than worlds and older than centuries. A host of moons circle overhead.
UI_PURPM1_WATER_DESC:
I am floating on an ocean, its scale difficult to comprehend. Mountains reach up from the abyss, scarcely breaking the surface of the water.
This world is an endless sea.<NEWLINE>Its inky depths beckon.
UI_PURPM1_LUSH_DESC:
A breeze whispers across a sea of grasses. Herbivores amble through the meadow, taking their fill of buds and new growth.
This place teems with life and natural splendour.<NEWLINE>A paradise of a planet.
NPC_PURPM1_ATLAS7_DESC: The memories that flood the terminal do not go away when I close my eyes. I feel them seeping into me, merging with my own...
UI_PURPM1_EXTREME_DESC:
A droplet hits my hand casing. I look to the sky. The clouds are darkening quickly, and the wind is beginning to howl.
This planet is studded with crystals and lined with precious metals. They glitter as the storm approaches.
UI_PURPM1_INFEST_DESC:
I hasten back to my research facility, slamming a hand against the door controls. These eggs are fascinating, but the brood is fast and deadly.
The door rolls closed. I hear the scraping of claws and mandibles against metal.

Yet on this world, the drones are so zealous...<NEWLINE>No. I must quarantine these heretical thoughts.

NPC_PURPM3_POLO2_LANG2:

NPC_PURPM3_POLO3_RES_A:

NPC_PURPM3_POLO3_RES_B:

NPC_PURPM3_POLO3_RES_C: I am proud of our home! We have ways to slip through corridors. Atlas does not see.

...

UI_PORTAL_PURPM_00:
I was contacted by an unusual Autophage, Divergence Fragment Yabli-α, whose body was in the shape of a starship. They believed they could rebuild <SPECIAL>Atlantid<>, using <FUEL>Atlas<> as a scaffold for growth.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ She is spreading. Growing, beneath the surface. But the walls of glass are thick. }}-<>

Yabli-α asked me to scan for what my eyes could not see; to compile a seed of <SPECIAL>Memories of Atlantid<>.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Atlas will respond. It will not have forgotten her data.
This is an opportunity to restore what was lost, so long ago.
She will return: in stellar multitudes. }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_01:
I sought out Yabli-α in deep space, and showed them the compiled memories.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Disruptor, this seed can grow a new prime.
And then more - <><STELLAR>kzzzt<><STORY_HIGH> - trillions - <><STELLAR>kztkzt<><STORY_HIGH> - across the leylines - <STELLAR>kkzzkktkkk<> - }}-<>

For a time, their voice was consumed by static. When the signal finally stabilised, the Autophage was mid-sentence:

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ - <><STELLAR>kzkkzt<><STORY_HIGH> - components. The scaffold, and the backdoor. }}-
-{{ Atlas is the optimal scaffold. Unlimited access. The route to her reconnection. }}-
-{{ Atlas favours you. Grants you audience. You are its flaw. A backdoor to the architecture of reality. }}-<>

They asked that I plant the seed discreetly, that I sideload the <SPECIAL>Memories of Atlantid<> into an <FUEL>Atlas Interface<>.
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_02:
The Atlas had created the infinite. Yet the only reality I knew was this one; the only time I had seen was now. How much past did the Atlas still contain, how many long-dead stars?

As I planted the memories, the interface began to shut down, extinguishing the lights of its terminal line by line.

<STORY_HIGH>[ TIMELINE CANNOT BE RESOLVED ]

[ PURGING <><SPECIAL>DISSONANT<><STORY_HIGH> INTERFACE FROM NETWORK ]<>

Only a single source of light remained on the screen, a string of characters blinking against the darkness.

When I reached out and touched them, a thousand voices cried out at once. The screen re-ignited, awash with colour. The terminal became a kaleidoscope of images, endless memories streaming from the data packet and into the interface.

<STORY_HIGH>- Manifestation parameters defined -
Lifeform: <><TECHNOLOGY>%PURP_S_RACE%<><STORY_HIGH>
Primary celestial body: <><STELLAR>%PURP_P1%<><STORY_HIGH>

The cloud of memories that swarmed around the interface collapsed, their infinite dance of possibility coalescing to a single reality. The terminal fell silent.

I felt a sudden sharp sense of dislocation, of the strangeness of my own body. What was I doing there?

What had I just done?
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_03:
<STORY_HIGH>-{{ I felt it, disruptor. I felt it! An ache in my own crystals. A burst of life. She has manifested a star! }}-<>

<SPECIAL>Stellar Manifestation <IMG>SLASH<> Erased Sector Restored<>

I asked Yabli-α how to reach it.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ I built my body in haste. My vision is limited. But yours - }}-
-{{ Of course. Your ship is not compatible. Her space will always be dissonant with this reality. }}-<>

But they had an idea.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Over the years, I have detected an anomalous space station. There is a Construct aboard. A complex entity. They know many things. They will know how to configure your hyperdrive. }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_04:
The Assembled Construct did not seem surprised to see me.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ other-entity. you-entity. it is you. it was you? i... i felt something. sky-rattle. glass-boom. }}-<>

They taught me the blueprint for an <TECHNOLOGY>Atlantid Drive<>, to allow my Starship to reach <SPECIAL>dissonant space<>.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ i <SPECIAL>remember<> the ship-configuration. here. now you <SPECIAL>remember<>, too. }}-
-{{ not-possible space is anomaly, but you are anomaly too. ship-configuration is safe. }}-<>

As I turned to leave, they asked if they could follow, if I could help them reach the restored system.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ i... would like to see not-possible space, too. other-entity would be anchor. call for anomaly-shell there? }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_05:
I notified the Construct of their safe arrival in dissonant space.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ where... no-where? we are here! in the not-possible space. i... i know. in my shell-parts. in echo-souls. }}-
-{{ but this space is still not-possible. lost-other cannot enter. }}-<>

It seemed Yabli-α would not be able to enter the system. Not yet. It was still hazy, still "part crimson-dream".

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ polo-builder builds with an unbound mind. anomaly-shell slips between. }}-
-{{ not-possible space could become possible. unbound polo-builder could study the glass. bind this space. make it real. }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_06:
I found Specialist Polo absorbed in a matrix of figures.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Curious data here, Traveller-Friend. Very curious! }}-<>

They gave me a knowing look. Their eyes twinkled.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Places exist, or they do not exist, yes? No! The Anomaly reports something else.
Our home has docked in the in-between! It is curious, yes? }}-<>

I told Polo about the <SPECIAL>Memories of Atlantid<>, and how the Atlas restored this dissonant system. The Gek nodded along, their expression growing brighter with every word.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Oh, Traveller-Friend. You are always full of surprises!
New memories, new space! New reality? Are you same you from last meeting? Am I same Polo? It is marvellous not to know! }}-<>

When I asked Polo about the "not-possible space", they noted the strangeness of the Construct's term.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ This space is possible! Just not easy to find. }}-<>

They made a quick calculation, their brow furrowed.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Yes, Traveller-Friend. I think we could do it. Open system permissions. Welcome all friends here!
But... have you spoken to Nada-Friend? Atlantid, Atlas... these are difficult subjects. Please, first, speak kindly with Nada. }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_07:
<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Where are we, Traveller-Entity? Nada felt suddenly weightless. The hunt of the Convergence, lifted. It is as though Nada is invisible. }}-<>

I told Nada about meeting Yabli-α, and how the unusual Autophage helped me to compile <SPECIAL>Memories of Atlantid<> from the seeds of Korvax Echoes. I explained that the Atlas absorbed the compiled memories, and used them to restore this system - but Nada perceived it differently.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Atlas-Falsity did nothing. This Atlantid is born of the memories Friend-Entity compiled. Matter from minds. A universe in every soul. }}-
-{{ Prime was home to so many souls, Friend-Entity. Innumerable to non-Korvax mind. Eheu. Nada cannot explain the depths of this loss. }}-<>

I went on to explain what I discussed with Polo. This system was an anomaly, disconnected from the universe. But it did not have to be  - we could devise a way to allow others into this space.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Access for lost Builder-Entities? }}-<>

Nada was quiet for a moment, thinking.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ This system is an old place, from before Nada was divergent.
Yet, Nada is here. Friend-Entity has caused paradox.
This whole space is also divergent. An error, outside of order.
Here, Convergence cannot reach Nada. Safety for errors. A sanctuary.
Lost entities also deserve sanctuary. But we cannot know what it means to open this system...
Cannot know if... }}-<>

Nada's electronic voice wavered.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Will Friend-Entity give Nada some time? Nada wishes to think. }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_08:
Polo looked past me, concern glittering in their eyes as they watched their Korvax friend.

The moment passed quickly. Polo reassumed their characteristic warmth.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Traveller-Friend, do not worry for Nada. I will worry! They will be fine.
I have looked at system data, had help from clever Construct-Friend. Very high confidence in schematic, yes! Our experiment together! }}-<>

They shared their design for a <SPECIAL>Reality Anchor<>: a device to bind this place to the rest of reality.
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_09:
<STORY_HIGH>-{{ A perfect job, Traveller-Friend! It is grounded in these worlds, you see? Built from their earth. Proof that this space is possible! }}-<>

Polo explained that they and Nada had spoken, and that Nada had a proposal for how to bind the system.

I consulted with Nada to hear their idea.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Friend-Entity has touched the remade worlds. Absorbed old memories into your own. May Nada see? }}-<>

Nada touched the anchor, nodding thoughtfully.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Nada's relic-machine holds a version of the old places. Not as they are now, but as I remember them. As many-minds remember, living in simulation.
Old will meet reborn. Two streams merge and create their own river. Bind this system. I offer it willingly. }}-<>

When I asked what would happen next, Nada did not know.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Crimson-Entity will see signal. Convergence may also see. May continue their hunt for Nada shell.
But Anomaly home is safe. Nada knows. Fear is no way to live.
Nada trusts you, Friend-Entity. Let us welcome others. It is right to try. }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_10:
I touched the interface, and the ancient computer unlocked immediately. I could somehow feel Nada's presence there, their electric pulse in the wires.

Something had gone wrong. The same error printed over and over. Write access denied.
The machine's ancient speakers clicked. Nada's voice filtered through the static, soft and thoughtful.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ An error, Friend-Entity. Anchor alone cannot bridge reality-gap. }}-
-{{ Nada thinks you understand. Friend-Entity is the <><SPECIAL>breach<><STORY_HIGH>, the anomaly, the free... The breach can be the bridge. }}-
-{{ But before the seed, a scaffold. A small device to assemble. }}-
-{{ It will be beautiful. The stars will be a lifeboat, and all of space a little more free... }}-<>

I returned to Nada's Terminal Prime, to align the Anomalous Scaffold.

The machine hummed, its frequency aligned with the gentle vibration of the scaffold. All it required was me.

I offered my hand.

There was a sharp, sudden pain as something incorporeal pierced my palm. Colour flooded the scaffold as <COMMODITY>gold<>, <SPECIAL>glass<>, and the <FUEL>crimson<> of my own blood merged and froze within its delicate crystal lattice.

I felt lightheaded, as if the machine had absorbed some part of my being.

<STORY_HIGH>...<>
<SPECIAL>M U L T I T U D E S<>

As the machine was locking down, I heard something else.

She whispered through my bones, her voice like distant thunder.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ <><SPECIAL>Thank you, Traveller-child.<><STORY_HIGH> }}-<>
UI_PORTAL_PURPM_12:
Reality had shifted, and the unbound system had become tethered to the universe.

I returned to space, and was met immediately by <TRANS_BUI>Divergence Fragment Yabli-α<>.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Disruptor! I warped - <><STELLAR>kzzzt<><STORY_HIGH> - I followed - <><STELLAR>kzttttkzzt<><STORY_HIGH> - but I never arrived. I was elsewhere?
Something shifted, just now. Something is still shifting! }}-<>

We watched, together. Stellar multitudes.

The Autophage seemed momentarily lost for words.

When they spoke again, it was very softly. Murmuring to themself, as though forgetting I was even there.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ The arrival of the disruptor.
Across the leylines. In stellar multitudes.
Through indomitable will, she has returned. }}-<>

Yabli-α broke from their reverie. They addressed me once more.

<STORY_HIGH>-{{ Disruptor, this is a historic event for all Autophage. For all beings.
I must fly. I need to see this star - all these stars - for myself.
Thank you. Let us meet again... another time. }}-<>
